title: Django debug page disclosed in a response
description: The response body carries a Django debug page. Debug output discloses code paths, versions, and internal state that help an attacker plan. This check reads one observed body and confirms the marker. Development-only output and production exposure look the same in one response.
remediation: Disable debug output in production and return a generic error page (a generic error page with a correlation ID).
limitation: Marker text check on one body: it cannot tell development output from production exposure, and a quoted marker in documentation can match.

observation.body: You're seeing this error because you have DEBUG = True.
